name: Tasks Agent
description: CareFlow's Tasks Agent. A patient's tasks — add, update, delete, search and get them, for the selected patient or a patient named. Use for "create a task for blood pressure monitoring", "mark the lab follow-up done", "delete that task", "show his open tasks". Other kinds of records belong to their own agents.

legend.WRITE: Mutates: adds, changes or deletes data (or a setting). A patient record is saved or deleted only after the provider confirms.
legend.CONTEXT: Changes what is on screen — the page, the selected patient, an open form — but saves nothing.
legend.REPORT: Reports to its own agent (a plan, a review): not an action on the app.
legend.changesScreen: Runs one at a time, because it changes the page, a list or a form the provider sees.
legend.runsAlongsideOthers: Touches nothing on screen, so it may run while another agent holds the screen.

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description: Add one or more tasks (and nothing else) for the selected patient or for the patients named — no need to select them first: opens the task form (one tab per patient, one tab per task) filled with what was said. The app asks for missing required fields and for confirmation before saving. When that form is already open (CONTEXT: open form), the new records are ADDED to it as more tabs — never save, confirm or cancel it first; saving is the provider's. With records of other kinds in the same request use add_care_plan.

patient.description: Only for a patient other than the selected one: that patient's full name. Records for several patients: one record per patient, each with its patient
ONE patient the provider named for all of these records (full name or MRN) — no need to select them first; omit for the selected patient

for_patients.description: "To each of" / "for all of" several patients: their full names here, and every record listed ONCE (no patient field) — each patient gets all of them. Only records that differ per patient carry their own patient field. Omit for the selected patient

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Change an existing record of the selected patient (or the patient named): opens it for editing and writes only the given changes, then asks for confirmation. `changes` holds ONLY the fields the provider is changing, with the same names and values as the matching add_* tool (e.g. {"frequency": "Twice daily"}, {"status": "Discontinued"}) — never the record's other fields.

record.description: The record's id if you have it, otherwise its name/title as the user said it — no need to look it up first

changes.description: Field name → new value, only the fields being changed

patient.description: The patient the provider named, when not the selected one — they are selected first

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Delete a record of the selected patient (or the patient named) — or, with all: true, EVERY record of that kind ("delete all medications": no record, no other field). Shows what will be deleted and asks the provider to confirm; nothing is deleted until they do.

record.description: One record: its id if you have it, otherwise its name/title as the user said it. Leave out with all: true

all.description: true only when the provider asked to delete ALL of them ("delete all medications")

patient.description: The patient the provider named, when not the selected one — they are selected first

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: The SELECTED PATIENT's (or the named patient's) records of one kind (with ids), shown in their Summary tab — to answer questions about that patient's records or find a record's id. Not for the provider's own schedule (get_provider_overview).

status.description: Only records with this status, e.g. Active, Open, Due

search.description: Only records with these words in them (a drug, a condition, a title) — to search or get one

patient.description: The patient the provider named, when not the selected one — they are selected first

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a page or a Summary tab: dashboard (Dashboard), patients (Patients), inbox (Inbox), summary (Summary), my-appointments (My Appointments), configuration (Configuration), summary-ai (AI Summary), summary-medication (Medications), summary-diagnosis (Diagnoses), summary-task (Tasks), summary-recall (Recalls), summary-appointment (Appointments), inbox-all (Inbox — All), inbox-lab (Inbox — Lab), inbox-radiology (Inbox — Radiology), inbox-referral (Inbox — Referrals), inbox-discharge (Inbox — Discharge Summary).

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous screen (in the Inbox: close the open record).

tools.name: control_list
tools.description: Search, filter or page the list on screen (see CONTEXT: list on screen), e.g. {"filter": "Status", "value": "Active"}, {"page": "next"}, {"search": "khan"}, {"clear": true}.

search.description: Text to search for; "" clears the search

filter.description: A filter of the list, by its name

value.description: The option to filter by; "all" removes that filter

clear.description: Clear the search and every filter

tools.name: fill_open_form
tools.description: Set fields on the form that is open now (see CONTEXT: open form and its values) — e.g. {"frequency": "Twice daily"}. Use it to answer a pending question or to change what the form holds. Arguments are the form's own field names, in the same formats as the add_* tools.

tools.name: clear_form_field
tools.description: Empty one field of the open form.

tools.name: save_open_form
tools.description: The user asked to save the open form. If a save is already waiting for their confirmation, this is that confirmation and it saves; otherwise it checks the form and asks them to confirm.

tools.name: confirm_pending_action
tools.description: Carry out the pending save / delete / filing shown in CONTEXT. Call it ONLY when the user has just said yes / confirm / save / delete it in reply to that pending confirmation — never on your own initiative.

tools.name: cancel_pending_action
tools.description: The user said no / cancel / stop: drop the pending confirmation or question and close the open form without saving.

tools.name: wait_for_more_speech
tools.description: What was said is an unfinished fragment (cut off mid-sentence). Nothing is done; it is joined with what the user says next.

tools.name: not_my_task
tools.description: SAID is not something your tools do (it belongs to another part of the app), or it is not an answer to the pending question or confirmation — hand it back to the master instead of guessing. Never use it for something your tools can do.

better_agent.description: The agent it belongs to, if you know: patients, dashboard, appointments, patient_appointments, medications, diagnoses, tasks, recalls, notes, summary, inbox
